Photo.title: Photo
Photo.description: Event photo shared by attendees to be displayed on the live mural / telão.

imageUrl.description: Download URL, public image link, or optimized data URI of the uploaded photo.

author.description: Name or handle of the guest who shared the photo.

caption.description: Optional caption or message for the event wall.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the photo was recorded.

/photos/{photoId}.description: Public stream of live event photos for the gallery and screen projection.
